sentences.en: Only cleaners are authorized to enter into the meeting room.
sentences.zh: 只有清洁工被授权进入会议室。

sentences.en: Only authorized individuals are allowed to enter the demilitarized zone.
sentences.zh: 只有获准的人才能进入非军事区。

sentences.en: We authorize the workers to take company cars home.
sentences.zh: 我们授权员工可以将公司车辆开回家。

senses.zh: 授权；批准；允许；委任（等于authorize）
